info.title: API.SH: Seek
info.description: The Seek API from API.SH: public Seek data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

A company's SEEK profile: name, website, size, industry, location, specialities, description, mission, logo, overall and per-category ratings (benefits, career, diversity, management, work-life balance, environment), star counts, recommendation and salary sentiment, perks, culture, awards, the reviews the page shows (pros, cons, role, ratings) and related companies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seek-company

parameters.name: id

get.description:
One SEEK job ad: full description (HTML and text), advertiser (verified, registered since), location and area, work type, work arrangements, classification, salary as advertised, listed and expiry dates, status, the screening questions shown on the ad, bullet points, and the company profile summary (industry, size, rating) when the employer has one. Removed or expired ads answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seek-job

parameters.description: Job id (the number in `seek.com.au/job/<id>`) or the job URL.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Which SEEK site (detected from a `seek.co.nz` URL).

get.description:
Jobs on SEEK (Australia or New Zealand) with the site's filters: location and distance, sort, listing date, work type, work arrangement, classification, salary range. `total` is SEEK's count. Each job: `id`, `title`, `url`, `company`, `advertiser`, `location`, `locations`, `classification`, `sub_classification`, `classifications`, `work_types`, `work_arrangements`, `salary` (as advertised), `teaser`, `bullet_points`, `listed_at`, `listed_label`, `featured`, `logo` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seek-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Suburb, city, region or state, e.g. `Sydney`, `Melbourne VIC 3000`, `Auckland`.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Radius around the location, in km.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.description: Classification ids, comma-separated (e.g. `6281` Information & Communication Technology; ids appear in `jobs[].classifications`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
